# BLS 4.0 ingredient-preferred code list
#
# The subset of Bundeslebensmittelschluessel 4.0 that represents raw/base INGREDIENTS, as opposed
# to prepared menu components and cooking-state variants. Used by the degraded-mode BLS policy as
# the candidate pool for fuzzy matching (see bls-provider.ts); it is deliberately NOT a ranking
# bonus in healthy mode, because the curation is icon-driven and keeps arbitrary variants within a
# food (e.g. Camembert 30% is kept while 45% is dropped).
#
# Every code here also exists in the full 7,140-row runtime database; this list only sets the
# ingredient_preferred flag on those rows. There is exactly ONE runtime BLS database.
#
# selection: EiSiMo/bls-icons canonical items.csv; BLS main groups B-W only; X/Y menu components excluded
# source:    Bundeslebensmittelschlüssel (BLS) 4.0 (2025)
# doi:       10.25826/Data20251217-134202-0
# license:   CC BY 4.0
# publisher: Max Rubner-Institut
# count:     2992
